dh2.creationHintsIntro: Generated when the character was created. Copy the values to the sheet manually, then delete this block.
dh2.influenceLimitHint: At creation you may take up to Influence bonus acquisitions
dh2.acquisitionLimitExceeded: More than the Influence bonus — the GM decides.
dh2.requisitionHint: The app only calculates the target; the player rolls.
dh2.selectHomeWorldError: You must select a home world.
dh2.selectCareerPathError: You must select a career path.
dh2.placeholderUnderhive: Born in the underhive of Scintilla...
dh2.characterCreatedDescDH: Your new Dark Heresy character has been saved.
dh2.selectAdvancedPathDesc: Your experience has unlocked new possibilities. This choice is permanent for this character.
dh2.selectAlternateRankDesc: Choose your rank for the 2000-2999 EXP tier.
dh2.data.divination.onlyTheInsane: Only the insane have strength enough to prosper. Only those who prosper may judge what is sane.
dh2.data.divination.sinsHidden: Sins hidden in the heart turn all to decay.
dh2.data.divination.painOfBullet: The pain of the bullet is ecstasy compared to damnation.
dh2.data.divination.killTheAlien: Kill the alien before it can speak its lies.
dh2.data.divination.knowTheMutant: Know the mutant; kill the mutant.
dh2.data.divination.offerHisLife: Even a man who has nothing can still offer his life.
dh2.data.divination.jobWorthDying: If a job is worth doing it is worth dying for.
dh2.data.divination.onlyInDeath: Only in death does duty end.
dh2.data.divination.mindWithoutPurpose: A mind without purpose will wander in dark places.
dh2.data.divination.noCivilians: There are no civilians in the battle for survival.
dh2.data.divination.spiritNotBroken: Die if you must, but not with your spirit broken.
dh2.data.divination.gunMightier: The gun is mightier than the sword.
dh2.data.divination.boonToBrothers: Be a boon to your brothers and bane to your enemies.
dh2.data.divination.menMustDie: Men must die so that Man endures.
dh2.data.divination.onlyTrueFear: The only true fear is of dying with your duty not done.
dh2.data.divination.thoughtBegetsHeresy: Thought begets Heresy; Heresy begets Retribution.
dh2.data.divination.wiseManLearns: The wise man learns from the deaths of others.
dh2.data.divination.suspiciousMind: A suspicious mind is a healthy mind.
dh2.data.divination.noSubstituteForZeal: There is no substitute for zeal.
dh2.data.divination.askHowNotWhy: Do not ask why you serve. Only ask how.
dh2.data.divination.darkDreams: Dark dreams lie upon the heart.
dh2.data.divination.darknessLightOfTerra: In the darkness, follow the light of Terra.
games.dh2.name: 2nd Edition
games.dh2.description: Dark Heresy 2e: Influence, second-edition fatigue and +30 training.
dh2.bulkStatsDesc: Defaults to 30. Set correct values from your sheets.
dh2.bulkVitalsDesc: Sets maximum values. Current values and notes are preserved.
dh2.duplicatesHint: A duplicate is replaced by a free characteristic aptitude.
dh2.instantChangesHint: Changes are shown as a memo; the sheet is not changed automatically.
dh2.eliteRemoveHint: Removing does not roll back characteristics or XP.
dh2.elitePrereq.astropath: Psyker elite advance; Adeptus Astra Telepathica background; GM guidance.
dh2.elitePrereq.inquisitor: Influence 75; Emperor's Blessing (an Inquisitor's decree); GM guidance.
dh2.elitePrereq.psyker: Willpower 40; A Beacon in the Warp (not with Untouchable); GM guidance.
dh2.elitePrereq.sister-of-battle: Influence 50; Willpower 40; Adepta Sororitas background; GM guidance.
dh2.elitePrereq.untouchable: A Void in the Warp (not with Psyker); GM guidance.
dh2.psyPurchaseHint: The price is only a hint; XP is written to the journal.
dh2.psyFreeTextHint: Enter disciplines and powers from the book, comma-separated.
dh2.focusPowerHint: Usually Willpower; the power's description may name another characteristic.
dh2.rollHint: The default is the minimum of the range — enter your roll at the table.
dh2.characteristicsHint: Roll 2d10+20 for each characteristic at the table and enter the result. The home world marks which characteristics roll 3d10 (keep the highest or the lowest two).
dh2.divinationHint: Roll 1d100 at the table and pick the row of Table 2-9.
dh2.xpWarningNegative: The purchase costs more than the remaining XP; the sheet allows it for house rules, but check the balance.
dh2.startingPackage: Starting package (hint, add manually on the sheet)
dh2.unresolvedChoices: some slots are not chosen yet
dh2.noFreeAptitudes: No free characteristic aptitudes left — choose the replacement manually on the sheet.
dh2.spendHint: The price is entered by the player: the app does not check legality (book and GM decide).
dh2.experienceLogHint: Purchases recorded by the player; entries can be deleted.
dh2.chosenAtCreation: Chosen at creation — recreate the character to change it.
dh2.conditions.name: Name
dh2.conditions.title: Conditions
dh2.addExperienceHint: Positive numbers are awards, negative are penalties. The entry goes to the XP journal; deleting it reverts the change.
Incorruptible Devotion: Whenever an Adepta Sororitas character would gain 1 or more Corruption Points, she gains that many Insanity Points minus 1 (to a minimum of 0) instead.
dh2.catalog.background.adeptus-administr: Master of Paperwork: all items count as one Availability level more available.
dh2.catalog.background.adeptus-arbites.b: The Face of the Law: re-roll any Intimidation or Interrogation test; may use Willpower bonus for degrees of success.
dh2.catalog.background.adeptus-astra-tel: The Constant Threat: when the character or an ally within 10 m triggers a Psychic Phenomenon roll, the result can be raised or lowered by the Willpower bonus.
Tested on Terra: taking the Psyker elite advance during creation also grants the Sanctioned trait.
dh2.catalog.background.adeptus-mechanicu: Replace the Weak Flesh: all cybernetics count as two Availability levels more available.
dh2.catalog.background.adeptus-ministoru: Faith is All: when spending a Fate point for +10 to a test, the bonus is +20 instead.
dh2.catalog.background.exorcised.bonus.0: Touched by a Daemon: An Exorcised character counts his Insanity bonus as 2 higher for purposes of avoiding Fear tests (see page 289 of the Dark Heresy Core Rulebook). Additionally, he can never again become possessed by the same Daemon that once possessed him.
dh2.catalog.background.heretek.bonus.0: Master of Hidden Lores: When a Heretek makes a Tech-Use test to comprehend, use, repair, or modify an unfamiliar device, he gains a +20 bonus if he has one or more relevant Forbidden Lore skill specialisations at Rank 1 (Known) or higher.
dh2.catalog.background.imperial-guard.bo: Hammer of the Emperor: when attacking a target an ally attacked since the end of the Guardsman's last turn, re-roll 1s and 2s on damage rolls.
dh2.catalog.background.imperial-navy.bon: Close Quarters Discipline: An Imperial Navy character scores one additional degree of success on successful Ballistic Skill tests he makes against targets at Point-Blank range, at Short range, and with whom he is engaged in melee.
dh2.catalog.background.mutant.bonus.0: Twisted Flesh: A Mutant character can always choose to fail any test associated with resisting malignancy or mutation. Whenever he would gain a malignancy, he may roll on Table 8–16: Mutations to gain a mutation instead.
dh2.catalog.background.outcast.bonus.0: Never Quit: Toughness bonus counts as two higher for determining Fatigue.
dh2.catalog.background.rogue-trader-flee: Inured to the Xenos: A character from a Rogue Trader Fleet gains a +10 bonus to Fear tests caused by aliens and a +20 bonus to Interaction skill tests with alien characters.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-01.effect: Roll once on Table 8-15 Malignancies and apply the result.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-02.effect: Perception +5; gains the Phobia mental disorder.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-06: Humans must die so that humanity can endure.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-06.effect: Gains the Jaded talent; if already possessed, Willpower +2 instead.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-10: The pain of the bullet is ecstasy compared to damnation.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-10.effect: Agility -3; on the first Critical damage each session roll 1d10: on 10 no Critical Effects (damage still counts as Critical).
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-100: Do not ask why you serve. Only ask how.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-14: Be a boon to your allies and the bane of your enemies.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-14.effect: Gains the Hatred (choose any) talent; if already possessed, Strength +2 instead.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-18: The wise learn from the deaths of others.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-18.effect: Agility or Intelligence +3; Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill -3.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-22: Kill the alien before it can speak its lies.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-22.effect: Gains the Quick Draw talent; if already possessed, Agility +2 instead.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-26.effect: Perception +3; the first time Corruption would be gained each session, gain 1 more.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-30.effect: Intelligence -3; the first time Corruption would be gained each session, gain 1 less (minimum 0).
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-34.effect: Fellowship or Strength +3; Toughness or Willpower -3.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-39: A mind without purpose wanders in dark places.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-39.effect: When gaining Mental Disorders, may choose a new Disorder instead of increasing the severity of an existing one.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-44: If a job is worth doing, it is worth dying for.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-44.effect: Toughness or Willpower +3; Fellowship or Strength -3.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-50: Dark dreams lie upon the heart.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-50.effect: When rolling on Table 8-15 Malignancies, may instead select any one result.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-55.effect: Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill +3; Agility or Intelligence -3.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-60: Ignorance is a wisdom of its own.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-60.effect: Perception -3; the first time Insanity would be gained each session, gain 1 less (minimum 0).
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-64: Only the insane have strength enough to prosper.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-64.effect: Willpower +3; the first time Insanity would be gained each session, gain 1 more.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-68: A suspicious mind is a healthy mind.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-68.effect: Perception +2; may re-roll Awareness tests to avoid being Surprised.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-72.effect: Toughness -3; on the first damage each session gain +20 to the next test before the end of the next turn.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-76: The only true fear is dying without your duty done.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-76.effect: Gains Resistance (Cold, Heat, or Fear); if already possessed, Toughness +2 instead.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-80: Only in death does duty end.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-80.effect: The first time Fatigue would be suffered each session, suffer 1 less (minimum 0).
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-84.effect: Gains the Keen Intuition talent; if already possessed, Intelligence +2 instead.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-88.effect: Gains the Dodge skill as Known (rank 1); if already possessed, Agility +2 instead.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-92: There is no substitute for zeal.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-92.effect: Gains the Clues from the Crowds talent; if already possessed, Fellowship +2 instead.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-96: Even one who has nothing can still offer his life.
dh2.catalog.divination.d100-96.effect: When burning Fate threshold to survive a lethal injury roll 1d10: on 10 survive without reducing the Fate threshold.
dh2.catalog.elite.psyker.change.0: Psyker trait, Psyker aptitude, psy rating 1
dh2.catalog.elite.untouchable.change.2: Fellowship halved (counts as 1 vs psy rating/Psyniscience)
dh2.catalog.elite.untouchable.change.3: Ignores Psychic Phenomena; +30 vs Perils of the Warp
dh2.catalog.role.ace.bonus: Right Stuff: In addition to the normal uses of Fate points (see page 293 of the Dark Heresy Core Rulebook), an Ace character may spend a Fate point to automatically succeed at an Operate or Survival skill test involving vehicles or living steeds with a number of degrees of success equal to his Agility bonus.
dh2.catalog.role.assassin.bonus: Sure Kill: on a successful hit, spend a Fate point to add damage equal to degrees of success on the attack roll.
dh2.catalog.role.chirurgeon.bonus: Dedicated Healer: on a failed First Aid test, spend a Fate point to succeed with degrees of success equal to the Intelligence bonus.
dh2.catalog.role.crusader.bonus: Smite the Unholy: In addition to the normal uses of Fate points (see page 293 of the Dark Heresy Core Rulebook), a Crusader character can also spend a Fate Point to automatically pass a Fear test with a number of degrees of success equal to his Willpower bonus. In addition, whenever he inflicts a hit with a melee attack against a target with the Fear (X) trait, he inflicts X additional damage and counts his weapon's penetration as being X higher.
dh2.catalog.role.desperado.bonus: Move and Shoot: once per round, after a Move action, make a single Standard Attack with a pistol as a Free Action.
dh2.catalog.role.fanatic.bonus: Death to All Who Oppose Me!: In addition to the normal uses of Fate points (see page 293 of the DARK HERESY Core Rulebook), a Fanatic character may spend a Fate point to count as having the Hatred talent against his current foe for the duration of the encounter. Should he choose to leave combat against a Hated foe in that encounter, however, he gains 1 Insanity point.
dh2.catalog.role.hierophant.bonus: Sway the Masses: spend a Fate point to automatically succeed at a Charm, Command, or Intimidate test with degrees of success equal to the Willpower bonus.
dh2.catalog.role.mystic.bonus: Stare into the Warp: starts with the Psyker elite advance; Willpower 35+ is recommended.
dh2.catalog.role.penitent.bonus: Cleansing Pain: Whenever a Penitent character suffers 1 or more points of damage (after reductions for Toughness bonus and Armour), he gains a +10 bonus to the first test he makes before the end of his next turn.
dh2.catalog.role.sage.bonus: Quest for Knowledge: spend a Fate point to automatically succeed at a Logic or any Lore test with degrees of success equal to the Intelligence bonus.
dh2.catalog.role.seeker.bonus: Nothing Escapes My Sight: spend a Fate point to automatically succeed at an Awareness or Inquiry test with degrees of success equal to the Perception bonus.
dh2.catalog.role.warrior.bonus: Expert at Violence: after a successful attack test but before hits, spend a Fate point to use the WS/BS bonus instead of degrees of success.
dh2.catalog.talent.ambidextrous.hint: Fighting with two weapons is easier; the two-weapon penalty is reduced.
dh2.catalog.talent.bodyguard.hint: Use a Reaction to interpose yourself and take an attack aimed at an ally.
dh2.catalog.talent.clues-from-the-crowds: Can reroll a Fellowship test to gather information from a crowd.
dh2.catalog.talent.disarm.hint: Can disarm an opponent in melee.
dh2.catalog.talent.double-team.hint: Grants a bonus when outnumbering an enemy in melee.
dh2.catalog.talent.flagellant.hint: Pain cleanses: +10 to resist Fear, Pinning, psychic powers and Corruption for one encounter.
dh2.catalog.talent.hatred.hint: Grants a bonus against a chosen group; choose a specialisation.
dh2.catalog.talent.hotshot-pilot.hint: Suffer Fatigue to add or reduce degrees of success on Operate or Survival.
dh2.catalog.talent.iron-jaw.hint: A Toughness test can shake off Stunned.
dh2.catalog.talent.jaded.hint: Ignores mundane horrors without gaining Insanity.
dh2.catalog.talent.keen-intuition.hint: Can reroll a failed Awareness test at −10.
dh2.catalog.talent.leap-up.hint: Stand up as a Free Action.
dh2.catalog.talent.quick-draw.hint: Draw a weapon as a Free Action.
dh2.catalog.talent.resistance.hint: Grants +10 to resist a chosen threat; choose a specialisation.
dh2.catalog.talent.takedown.hint: Can knock an opponent down with a special attack.
dh2.catalog.talent.warp-sense.hint: Can use Psyniscience as a Free Action.
dh2.catalog.talent.weapon-training.hint: Use weapons of a chosen type without penalty.
dh2.catalog.world.agri-world.bonus: Strength from the Land: An agri-world character starts with the Brutal Charge (2) trait.
dh2.catalog.world.daemon-world.bonus: Touched by the Warp: A Daemon world native begins with one Rank in the Psyniscience skill. Should he gain this skill again in a later step of character creation, he instead gains one additional Rank in the skill. Note that he cannot purchase more Ranks of this skill unless he acquires the Psyker aptitude. This character also begins with 1d10+5 Corruption points.
dh2.catalog.world.death-world.bonus: Survivor's Paranoia: While a death world character is Surprised, non-Surprised attackers do not gain the normal +30 bonus to their Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill tests when targeting this character.
dh2.catalog.world.feral-world.bonus: The Old Ways: any Low-Tech weapon loses the Primitive quality (if it had it) and gains Proven (3).
dh2.catalog.world.feudal-world.bonus: At Home in Armour: A feudal world character ignores the maximum Agility value imposed by any armour he is wearing.
dh2.catalog.world.forge-world.bonus: Omnissiah's Chosen: starts with either the Technical Knock or Weapon-Tech talent.
dh2.catalog.world.frontier-world.bonus: Rely on None but Yourself: A frontier world character gains a +20 bonus to Tech-Use tests when applying personal weapon modifications, and a +10 bonus when repairing damaged items.
dh2.catalog.world.garden-world.bonus: Serenity of the Green: A garden world character halves the duration (rounded up) of any result from Table 8–11: Shock or Table 8–13: Mental Traumas (see pages 287 and 288 of the Dark Heresy Core Rulebook), and can remove Insanity points for 50xp per point rather than the normal 100xp.
dh2.catalog.world.highborn.bonus: Breeding Counts: any reduction of Influence is reduced by 1 less (minimum reduction of 1).
dh2.catalog.world.hive-world.bonus: Teeming Masses in Metal Mountains: ignores crowds for movement; +20 to Navigate (Surface) in enclosed spaces.
dh2.catalog.world.penal-colony.bonus: Finger on the Pulse: One survives a penal colony by instinctively knowing who is in charge and who is a threat. A penal colony character begins with one Rank in the Common Lore (Underworld) and Scrutiny skills, and starts with the Peer (Criminal Cartels) talent.
dh2.catalog.world.quarantine-world.bonus: Secretive by Nature: Those who manage to leave a quarantine world learn how to keep secrets. Whenever the warband's Subtlety would decrease, it decreases by 2 less (to a minimum reduction of 1).
dh2.catalog.world.research-station.bonus: Pursuit of Data: Whenever a research station character reaches Rank 2 (Trained) in a Scholastic Lore skill, he also gains Rank 1 (Known) in one related or identical Forbidden Lore skill specialisation of his choice. The GM is the final arbiter of whether the two specialisations are related.
dh2.catalog.world.shrine-world.bonus: Faith in the Creed: on spending a Fate point roll 1d10; on a 1 the Fate point is not spent.
dh2.catalog.world.voidborn.bonus: Child of the Dark: starts with the Strong Minded talent; +30 to tests for moving in zero gravity.
